subject: Re: MAP: Redwood x EdgeFin - Target Close & Procurement Deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood x EdgeFin MAP draft & target close

Hi Alex — great conversation this morning. Thanks for walking through the scope and success criteria. Per our call, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones, owners, and the target close date. Attachment: EdgeFin_MAP_v1.xlsx

Quick summary / proposed MAP highlights:
- Target commercial close: 2026-03-31 (end of Q1)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-03-24 (one week before close) — this gives our legal/commercial team time to process and schedule onboarding
- Key milestones and owners:
  • Kickoff & technical scoping (EdgeFin: Alex Foster) — target 2026-03-08
  • PO / procurement approval (EdgeFin: Samantha Lee) — target 2026-03-18
  • Contract signature (EdgeFin legal + Redwood legal) — target 2026-03-24
  • Onboarding start (Redwood delivery): within 5 business days after signature
- Dependencies: timely PO/approve, completion of security questionnaire (EdgeFin asks for SOC2 attestation; we already provided SOC2 report link in the doc)

Ask: Please review the MAP and confirm whether the proposed target close (2026-03-31) and procurement signature deadline (2026-03-24) are feasible for your internal timelines. If procurement/legal need a different deadline, call it out and we can propose a contingency plan.

Next steps: once we have alignment I will send v2 of the MAP with final dates and a DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Alex Foster <alex.foster@edgefin.com>

Thanks Marissa, and appreciate the clear MAP. Two quick notes from procurement/legal side:

1) Procurement timing — our procurement lead (Samantha) confirmed that because this is a multi-year contract and requires budget committee sign-off, the earliest our legal ops can complete signature end-to-end is the week of 2026-04-06. That puts a realistic contract-signature date at 2026-04-07, not 2026-03-24.

2) Legal review — they asked whether Redwood can accept signature by 2026-04-07 provided we hold pricing and resource commitment through that date. EdgeFin will provide a PO once committee approves, but the formal electronic signature will need to land by 2026-04-07.

We still want to move quickly — is your team flexible to align the MAP to a target close of 2026-04-07 for signature? If that doesn't work, we can escalate on our side to see if we can pull earlier approvals, but I wanted to surface this as the current constrained path.

Alex
Alex Foster
Head of Product, EdgeFin

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood x EdgeFin MAP - procurement timeline

Marissa / Dev — saw Alex's note. Procurement pushing to 2026-04-07 is workable but we should spell out options and risks for the customer in the MAP. Suggested compromises:

1) Align MAP target signature to 2026-04-07 (match EdgeFin ask). Update onboarding start: "within 5 business days after signature" and set go-live milestone accordingly.
2) Offer a phased / canary rollout scope to cover highest-priority endpoints so EdgeFin can start seeing value earlier even if full scope delivery slips. This reduces risk for both sides.
3) Ask for an early non-binding PO or purchase intent email by 2026-03-24 to reserve capacity and pricing. If they can commit to a PO or internal funding confirmation by that date, we will hold the quoted pricing and resource allocation through the 2026-04-07 sign date.
4) DocuSign: we should include a clause that the commercial terms are held until the signature deadline and that the Start of Services is tied to signature date. Legal to confirm, Dev to confirm delivery window impact.

I'll draft updated language for the MAP and a short email for Marissa to send to Alex/Samantha with the options. Dev — can you confirm if the delivery team has capacity to start the canary scope in late March if we get a PO by 2026-03-24?

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
